module SR44 (

    input B,
    input C,
    input CP,
    input D,
    input L,

    output QA,

    output QB,
    output QBN,
    output QC,
    output QCN,
    output QD,
    output QDN

  wire s_qb_n_out;

  wire s_d;

  wire s_plex3_out;

  /*******************************************************************************
   ** Here all input connections are defined                                     **
   *******************************************************************************/
  assign s_a  = A;
  assign s_b  = B;
  assign s_c  = C;
  assign s_cp = CP;
  assign s_d  = D;
  assign s_l  = L;

  assign QB   = s_qb_out;

  assign QDN  = s_qd_n_out;

  Multiplexer_2 PLEXERS_1 (
      .muxIn_0(s_si),

      .muxOut(s_plex1_out),
      .sel(s_l)
